content: Intersection-Observer-based scroll reveal in Next.js App Router: the hook/component must be a Client Component ('use client') because IntersectionObserver is a browser-only API. To avoid hydration mismatches, render a stable initial state (e.g. opacity-0/translateY unrevealed) identically on server and client, then flip visibility state only inside a useEffect after the observer fires client-side post-hydration -- never branch initial render output on typeof window !== 'undefined' or other server/client-diverging conditions. A reusable pattern: a client 'RevealOnScroll' wrapper component that takes children as props (server-rendered content passed through), attaches a ref, and toggles a CSS class/data-attribute on intersection -- keeps the reveal *mechanism* client-only while the *content* stays server-renderable.
